name: Job match pipeline
description: Fetch remote jobs -> clean them up -> AI compares them to a CV -> email the best matches.

sample_data.cv_text: Ada Example - Backend developer, 5 years. Python (FastAPI, asyncio, pandas), PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS (Lambda, S3). Built ETL pipelines and REST APIs for a fintech startup. Some React. BSc Computer Science. Looking for remote backend or data engineering roles.

parameters.system_prompt: You are a precise technical recruiter. Score candidates against job postings honestly; do not inflate scores.
parameters.prompt: Compare the candidate CV with each job posting. Score each job 0-100 for fit, and list concrete strengths and gaps (max 3 each). best_score is the highest score.

values.message: No job reached {{ vars.min_score }}/100; nothing sent.
